How to Play

1 CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER

Choose your island adventurer before starting the game.

🏴‍☠️ ZEPHY Jumps and stacks on Treasure Chests.
🌺 ZARA Jumps and stacks on Wooden Logs.
2 TIME YOUR JUMP
📱 Mobile🖱️ TAP Screen
💻 Desktop⌨️ Press SPACE

⚠️ The platform keeps moving while you're in the air! Time your jump carefully so your character lands on the moving platform.

3 LAND & STACK

Land safely on the moving Chest or Log. Each successful platform becomes part of your growing stack. The next platform will appear and continue the challenge. Keep jumping and build your stack as high as possible — miss the platform and the run ends!

4 EARN POINTS
⭐ PERFECT +2 PTS
🔥 COMBO +4 PTS
⚡ STREAK +10 PTS
Perfect: +2 Points
Perfect + Combo: +2 + 4 = 6 Points
Perfect + Streak: +2 + 10 = 12 Points
5 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD

Your total points become your score. Only your highest score is kept on the leaderboard. Each player name appears only once. Beat your best score and climb to the top!

💡 TIP
Don't jump just because the platform is under you. Remember — it keeps moving while you're in the air! Predict where it will be when you land.
